newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal tenders for stake in housing firm.
newsitem.headline: Senegal tenders for stake in housing firm.

text.p: Senegal on Monday launched a public tender for shares in the 90 percent state-owned housing company Societe Immobiliere du Cap-Vert (SICAP) as part of a wider privatisation programme.
A statement from the privatisation committee did not say what proportion on the government stake was up for sale.
"We will discuss that (the proportion of shares on offer) with the potential buyer," Serigne Ahmadou Kamara, head of the state privatisation committee told Reuters.
Founded in 1951 in the former French colony on the Atlantic coast of West Africa, SICAP has a capital of 2.7 billion CFA francs and has built 15,000 homes.
Apart from the 90 percent government stake, a remaining 10 percent is owned by a combination of private Senegalese investors and the French Caisse Francaise de Developpement.
The closing date for the tender is July 28.
